description: Sends one signed sample event with fake IDs to a webhook endpoint now and reports how the server answered. Use when the user wants to check a webhook works or debug a failing one. Not for past deliveries (use list_webhook_deliveries). Returns ok, the HTTP status, time taken and any error. Team managers only. The sample is not stored or retried.

event_type.description: Event type of the sample: workout_session.completed = a member finished a workout; plan.started = a member started a program; plan.progress_updated = program progress changed; plan.completed = a member finished a program; insights.digest_ready = a client insights digest is ready. Defaults to workout_session.completed.

team_id.description: Team to act on. Omit to use the signed-in team.

webhook_id.description: ID of the webhook endpoint. Get it from list_webhooks.

name: test_webhook
title: Send test webhook
